message: `aria-busy="true"` on the part sets the live region of `error` otherwise than its role does
$reason: An error part with its `alert` and `aria-busy="true"` beside it. Both engines expose the region as busy (measured on 2026-10-27: Chromium 153 `busy`, Firefox 158 `container-busy="true"` and the busy state). Chromium fires no change of a busy region (`ax_event_generator.cc`), and NVDA drops every event of a region whose `container-busy` is `true` (`ia2LiveRegions.cpp`): a message that changes while it is shown is not announced as one. Its entry is its `alert` event, which neither holds back. Point 7 read the part's role and politeness and what may hide it, and passed it.
